questions.question: What is plant stress?
questions.solution_html:
• • Plant stress refers to adverse conditions affecting plant growth.
  • • It leads to reduction in normal growth and development.
  • • Stress can cause damage to plant tissues.
  • • It is often caused by environmental factors like drought or heat.
  • • Plants respond to stress for survival.
questions.final_answer: • Plants respond to stress for survival

questions.question: Define unsupervised learning.
questions.solution_html:

  • • It helps in discovering hidden structures in datasets.

questions.question: Explain how AI supports nutrient prediction and recommendations.
questions.solution_html:
• • Data is collected from soil, crop, and environmental sources.
  • • Soil testing is done to identify nutrient levels.
  • • Crop stage is considered for accurate nutrient needs.
  • • Weather input is included for better prediction.
  • • The AI model is trained using collected data.
  • • The system learns patterns related to nutrient requirements.
  • • Nutrient deficiencies are detected by the model.
  • • AI provides fertilizer recommendations based on deficiency.
  • • It suggests the correct dose and timing of application.
  • • The final output helps farmers improve nutrient management.
questions.final_answer: • The final output helps farmers improve nutrient management
